meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为 NanoClaw 项目添加一个本地监控看板:安装配套软件包,修改启动文件让服务定期把数据库数据和运行日志推送出去,并在浏览器里展示代理组、会话、用户、消息、Token 用量和实时日志等页面。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 项目添加监控仪表盘/看板,或提到安装 @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard 时触发。

say.text: 给我的 NanoClaw 加上监控仪表盘吧
say.note: Claude 会按步骤安装并配置看板

say.text: 把 nanoclaw-dashboard 装进项目并接线
say.note: 会修改启动文件并添加环境变量

say.text: 在 NanoClaw 里部署一个本地监控面板
say.note: 装好后可访问 3100 端口的看板

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw: it installs the npm package, edits the startup file so the service periodically pushes database snapshots and log entries, and serves pages showing agent groups, sessions, users, messages, token usage, and real-time logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw or mentions installing @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to my NanoClaw.
Install nanoclaw-dashboard and wire it into the project.
say_en.note: Edits startup and adds env vars.

say_en.text: Set up a local monitoring panel for NanoClaw.
